components.title: Site ingress
components.description: The HAProxy Kubernetes Ingress controller in front of the site services.

control-implementations.description: What the site stack's rendered manifests show about the ingress controller.

implemented-requirements.description: The site stack renders no ingress-nginx controller.

statements.description: Every release of the site stack, rendered offline from the hash-checked vendored charts with the CI site file, contains no ingress-nginx reference, no nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io annotation and no nginx ingress class; the render test fails on any match.
statements.remarks: Your organization runs the ingress controller the site stack installs and adds no ingress-nginx controller to the cluster.

implemented-requirements.description: HAProxy serves every site address over TLS.

statements.description: HAProxy is the only and default ingress class and serves every rendered Ingress, publishing only HTTP and HTTPS on node ports with HTTP redirected to HTTPS. It replaces the forwarded headers a client could send rather than appending to them, verifies Keycloak with the site chain, and asks for a client certificate only when the site turns smart cards on, as an optional certificate whose authority the site names.
statements.remarks: Your organization runs the site's load balancer in front of the node ports and decides whether smart cards are on.

control-implementations.description: Supply-chain statements generated from the component inventory. Do not edit by hand: run node compliance/src/cli.ts supply-chain-statements --write.

implemented-requirements.description: Generated from the component inventory: the component inventory lists its resources.

statements.description: The component inventory (compliance/resources.json) lists these resources for Site ingress, each with the pin the repository uses: image docker.io/haproxytech/kubernetes-ingress 3.4.1@sha256:9dd24b69db53fa6dbaaad0a9d3d5da39363eff9103c589d0eff4ec57dcc04932 and chart kubernetes-ingress 1.57.1 (sha256:daedaa6bd3dae9ae9d735f8e1321bb89d3340893237273f0792a547cd91a4cbb). The compliance fit check over the whole repository, run as a CI test, fails when a resource the repository uses has no reviewed entry, or an entry lists a file that no longer uses it.
statements.remarks: Your organization keeps the inventory of what it installs at its site, with its owners, and reconciles it with this list.

implemented-requirements.description: Generated from the component inventory: the offline bundle import refuses a changed item.

statements.description: Before anything is copied to the site, the offline bundle import checks every item against the manifest your organization signed and refuses the bundle when an item is missing, extra or has another digest. For Site ingress that covers image docker.io/haproxytech/kubernetes-ingress 3.4.1@sha256:9dd24b69db53fa6dbaaad0a9d3d5da39363eff9103c589d0eff4ec57dcc04932 and chart kubernetes-ingress 1.57.1 (sha256:daedaa6bd3dae9ae9d735f8e1321bb89d3340893237273f0792a547cd91a4cbb). A CI test of the import proves the refusal.
statements.remarks: Your organization builds and signs each bundle it approves with its own key, and imports only that bundle at its site.

implemented-requirements.description: Generated from the component inventory: its resources are reviewed and pinned before use.

statements.description: These resources of Site ingress each have a reviewed register entry with their licence, compliance fit and conditions, and are pinned as the component inventory lists them: image docker.io/haproxytech/kubernetes-ingress 3.4.1@sha256:9dd24b69db53fa6dbaaad0a9d3d5da39363eff9103c589d0eff4ec57dcc04932 and chart kubernetes-ingress 1.57.1 (sha256:daedaa6bd3dae9ae9d735f8e1321bb89d3340893237273f0792a547cd91a4cbb). The compliance fit check over the whole repository, run as a CI test, fails when one of them has no reviewed entry, is marked as not fitting, or is an image without a sha256 digest or an action without a full commit SHA.
statements.remarks: Your organization selects and accepts its suppliers and runs its own supply-chain risk management plan.

implemented-requirements.description: Generated from the component inventory: the offline bundle import accepts only what your organization signed.

statements.description: The offline bundle import accepts a bundle only when its manifest verifies with your organization's public key and refuses a bundle signed with any other key, so these items of Site ingress reach the site only as your organization signed them: image docker.io/haproxytech/kubernetes-ingress 3.4.1@sha256:9dd24b69db53fa6dbaaad0a9d3d5da39363eff9103c589d0eff4ec57dcc04932 and chart kubernetes-ingress 1.57.1 (sha256:daedaa6bd3dae9ae9d735f8e1321bb89d3340893237273f0792a547cd91a4cbb). A CI test of the import proves the refusal.
statements.remarks: Your organization keeps the signing key, signs only the releases it approves, and keeps its own record of each bundle it imports.
